newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kiwifruit NZ reports 11 pct rise in 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Kiwifruit NZ reports 11 pct rise in 1996 profit.

text.p: Farmer cooperative Kiwifruit New Zealand said on Thursday its preliminary result for 1996 showed profits up 11 percent at NZ$274.3 million.
Sales for the co-operative rose 12 percent and volumes 16 percent from 1995, giving a $4.36 return per tray.
Sales growth was achieved in all regions.

Chairman John Palmer warned that the stronger performance planned for 1997 would not show on the bottome line due to the continued appreciation of the New Zealand dollar against KNZ's main trading currencies.
Palmer said confirmation of the industry's strength was the recent signing of a $155 million funding package for the 1997 season.
The funding allows KNZ to make progressive grower payments from when fruit is submitted until receipts from sales start flowing when debt is repaid and KNZ moves into positive cashflow.
